description: List what an app can do for the user. Body { "serviceId": "<service_id from search_apps>" } (camelCase) answers actions[] with action_id, action_name, action_description and fields_for_action_details. Use it to pick the action that matches the request (Gmail "Send Email", Google Sheets "Add Row", HubSpot "Create Contact") before connecting or running anything. Public catalog, no sign-in needed.
name: list_app_actions
